purpose: Teach: 土器/怪奇/輸血/波形/上演/決心/変数/駒

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、出土した、本気で、絶対、土器、絶対、医学史、絶対、医療界、絶対、関心、絶対、寄せております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I've been genuinely grateful for your interest in the medical history and healthcare field all along.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Clear articulation. Warmth beneath the composure. A sentence that carries weight without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 怪奇、本気for、絶対、症例、絶対、医療現場で、絶対、どう、絶対、対応、絶対、されますか?先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: But in a real case like that—how would the medical team actually respond in the moment, sensei?
lines.style: Lean forward slightly in the voice. Genuine curiosity, not performance. Respectful but unafraid to ask the harder question. Earnest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。緊急、本気で、絶対、輸血、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、即時対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In emergencies like that, our team mobilised for immediate transfusion and stabilisation without hesitation.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. Not detached—this is lived experience. Steady cadence. The kind of clarity that comes from having done this before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心電図の、本気で、絶対、波形、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、注意深く、絶対、観察、絶対、されますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the cardiac monitor—the whole team would have been watching those waveforms constantly, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Thinking aloud, a half-question. Voice settles into the technical detail. Respectful acknowledgment of expertise, with genuine interest in how the pieces fit.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。病院主催の、本気で、絶対、上演、絶対、会、絶対、患者さん、絶対、ご招待しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The hospital actually arranged a theatre performance for some of our patients. It was part of their recovery support.
lines.style: Slightly softer than before. A small smile in the voice—not defensive, just noticing something generous. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 手術への、本気で、絶対、決心、絶対、患者さんと、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、共有されますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That kind of resolve—the shared commitment between patient and medical team—that's something you build together, isn't it?
lines.style: Almost gentle here. Not asking to show off knowledge, but to understand. A moment of reflection. Slightly uncertain, which makes it sincere.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。研究の、本気で、絶対、変数、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に、絶対、管理しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In research we're meticulous about controlling variables. Every detail matters when lives are involved.
lines.style: Firm without hardening. This is principle speaking. Measured tempo. The kind of precision that comes from long responsibility.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 将棋の、本気で、絶対、駒、絶対、慰問品、絶対、患者さんに、絶対、人気だそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the patients really responded well to the shogi pieces as comfort gifts. Small things sometimes mean more than we expect.
lines.style: Wondering aloud, with quiet recognition. The voice softens slightly. Not sentimental—just honest about what patients need. Trailing into genuine reflection.
